Document.title: Document
Document.description: User voice-transcribed and AI-formatted document record.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this document.

template.description: Template style used: Meeting Notes, Lecture Notes, Memo, Letter, Journal, etc.

transcript.description: Original or edited raw spoken transcript.

content.description: AI-generated structured document content with headings, paragraphs, and bullet points.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was initially created.
